description.en: The Número de Identificação Fiscal (NIF) is issued by the Direção-Geral das Contribuições e Impostos (DGCI), under the Ministry of Finance of Guinea-Bissau. It identifies taxpayers, including organisations, in the DGCI's fiscal database. NIF identifiers can be used to uniquely identify organisations in open data publications.

access.onlineAccessDetails: NIF identifiers can be validated through the DGCI's Kontaktu system and associated electronic tax forms. However, no standalone public facility for searching or verifying NIF identifiers has been identified.
access.guidanceOnLocatingIds: The NIF can be found on official fiscal registration documents issued by the Direção-Geral das Contribuições e Impostos (DGCI), or requested directly from the organisation.

data.dataAccessDetails: NIF identifiers are assigned by the DGCI and appear on official fiscal registration documents. No downloadable public dataset has been identified.

meta.source: Official Direção-Geral das Contribuições e Impostos (DGCI) Kontaktu portal and guidance documents, together with confirmation from a registered organisation
